definition.en: The International Labour Organization (ILO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that sets international labor standards and promotes social justice and decent work for all.
definition.hi: The International Labour Organization (ILO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that sets international labor standards and promotes social justice and decent work for all.

importanceInUpsc.en: The ILO is highly relevant for UPSC GS-3 as it provides the global framework for labor reforms, social security, and employment policies in India. Understanding its conventions helps in analyzing India's labor law codification and its commitment to international human rights and economic standards.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the tripartite structure of the ILO involving governments, employers, and workers.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of ILO conventions on Indian labor legislation and economic policy.
